spec.description:
Autex Verve Cube is a sculpted 3D acoustic wall panel that
animates spaces through the interplay of light, shadow, and architectural form.
Formed from 100% polyester fibre with an 80% recycled PET core, Verve Cube
features solid colour throughout without requiring edge capping. Available in
six distinctive profiles—Pillar, Flute, Ovolo, Pinstripe, Ridge, and
Windswept—across the full Autex Cube colour palette, it delivers sound
absorption (NRC 0.30+) and Group 1 fire compliance.
features:
Six
sculptural contoured profiles: Pillar, Flute, Ovolo, Pinstripe, Ridge,
Windswept

Solid through-core colour across the entire Autex Cube 23+ colour
palette

Constructed from 100% polyester fibre containing a minimum of 80%
recycled PET

Available in two thicknesses: 12mm (6mm edge) and 21mm (15mm
edge)

Full-height wall panel format measuring 2680mm or 2700mm height
by 1170mm width
Acoustic rating of NRC 0.30 and higher

Group 1 fire rating
compliant with AS ISO 9705 - 2003 and AS 5637.1

Seamless joint design where
panels join at pattern low points

Glue-free SpinFix mechanical mounting or
direct adhesive fixing options

Certified Carbon Neutral product with
third-party verified EPD

install: Ensure wall substrate is smooth, flat, clean, and dry
Acclimatise panels in the space for at least 24 hours prior to installation
Inspect profile repeat and plan alignment across the wall area

Apply
high-grab MS polymer adhesive evenly across panel backing or attach SpinFix
clips

Position panel on wall, engage seams tightly at pattern low points, and
press firmly across face

Trim perimeter cuts cleanly using a track saw with a
fine-toothed blade

limitations:

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Verve Cube is a full-height 3D contoured acoustic wall
panel crafted from 100% polyester Cube felt with an 80% recycled PET core and
solid through-colour. Available in six distinctive profiles (such as Flute,
Ovolo, and Pillar) and two thicknesses (12mm and 21mm) in 2680mm x 1170mm
sheets, it moulds flat walls into light-responsive architectural features.
Achieving sound absorption from NRC 0.30+ and Group 1 fire compliance under AS
ISO 9705, it provides a sculptural, carbon-neutral acoustic solution across
commercial, civic, and hospitality spaces.
